about_the_game:
Spring has arrived, let's start our urban romance life~

Official QQ Discussion Group:
864879210

About Us:
Hi, we are R.Y.Love♂!
We aim to create a highly free-to-explore urban life simulation.
Here, you can freely visit different locations, pursue various types of girls, and trigger all kinds of events.

Game Introduction:
In this game, you play as a young man living in the city, experiencing romantic stories with girls from various professions.

Girls' Professions:

  • Housewife

  • Office Receptionist

  • Shopping Mall Girl

  • Convenience Store Girl

  • Library Girl

  • Construction Site Woman

  • Massage Girl

  • Sakura Model

  • Street Racer Girl

  • Prison Guard Sister

  • Nurse Sister

  • Lawyer Sister

  • Childhood Friend (Fitness Girl)

  • Idol Singer Trainee

  • Company's Boss Lady

Game Features:
● Free map exploration—each building has its own function, including your apartment, office buildings, restaurants, factories, gyms, and more.
● 20 girls to pursue, each with 2 to 10 storylines (to be updated in future versions). Higher affection levels unlock private romantic content.
● Each girl has related mini-games that can improve various stats, helping to advance the storyline.

More:
This game is in its early stages, with the current version only 1.2GB. However, new content will be added monthly, featuring rich and spicy scenarios—stay tuned!
